note: v3126: The second eye on v3125: activate_budget was consumed in exactly one place, and the sibling that polls the SAME activate expression after a re-prepare kept a hardcoded 12.0. So shelf-cards and river-strip declared 30s — because the door own path, await thOpen with an 8s /api/sessions abort then a 12s thLoadSession abort, cannot fit in 12 — and then got 12 anyway on that route. One consumer honouring a key while its sibling ignores it is the shape REG-713 already records. Dormant on the happy path since _toTVD is same-document and these targets do not navigate between widths, which is exactly the kind of disagreement that surfaces later as a flake nobody can reproduce.
